name: Guilloche Banknote Engraving
summary: Every frame is printed like a banknote; Pulse's UV sweep breaks one rosette ring in coral and reveals the hidden context.
look: Cream security paper with wavy line fields, guilloche rosettes in a teal rainbow ink, microtext borders, hatch-engraved Instrument Serif numerals, a watermark window and coral serial numbers. A dark diagonal UV band exposes fluorescent text on the anomaly.

components.name: Guilloche rosette
components.role: generated concentric wavy rings and a spirograph core in teal rainbow ink

components.name: Microtext border
components.role: repeating product words along the frame

components.name: Engraved numeral
components.role: serif figures filled with a diagonal hatch plus a fine outline

components.name: Watermark window
components.role: clear oval where the Acme mark appears as if held to light

components.name: Serial number
components.role: coral mono numbering that counts per scene

components.name: UV band
components.role: diagonal dark strip revealing hidden fluorescent context text

motion.name: Rosette draw
motion.how: dash reveal while ring phase advances, linear, 4 s loop = two bars at 120 BPM

motion.name: UV sweep
motion.how: band crosses the certificate in 600 ms power2.inOut via clip-path, beat to beat

motion.name: Serial roll
motion.how: digits step per 16th note (125 ms) and lock on the downbeat

story: Hook: a note with an engraved denomination '38 — DASHBOARDS · SERIES FRIDAY', serial Nº 000038, and 'How many dashboards did you check today?'. Reveal: rosette rings phase outward on the drop, the watermark window clears to show the Acme mark, 'ACME PULSE' engraves in hatch caps. Proof: a checkout certificate — a rosette ring breaks in coral, '−18%' hatches in coral, the UV band freezes over 'since 09:42 · after deploy #2231', and the human presses the Roll back plate. CTA: 'Every metric. Every minute.' engraved, lockup, and a guilloche START FREE plate with serial.
adapt: Treat each object your product verifies (a payout, a certificate, a build, an identity check) as a note; generate rosettes in your brand colors and put the evidence in the UV-revealed text.

fit.risk: fine lines alias after compression; keep strokes ~2 px and use fewer, larger loops
